integrity.claim_scope: One theorem on component count, projective degree multiset and generic transverse analytic type for all integer \(m\ge3\).
integrity.evidence_boundary: Formal symbolic proof plus a finite exact regression for \(m=2,3,4,5,6\); the finite check is not the infinite proof.
integrity.independent_audit: Not performed; no publication or independent certification asserted.

scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the reduced singular support, the given standard edge embedding and generic transverse types only.
The nonreduced Jacobian scheme, higher-depth local germs and singular-scheme multiplicities are not determined.
General Hibi singular-orbit literature may contain an unindexed equivalent projective degree specialization.
title: Projective degrees of the singular strata of ladder-graph edge varieties
